subject: StellarSail onboarding plan & CS owner assignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@stellarsail.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <p.nair@stellarsail.com>, StellarSail Legal <legal@stellarsail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: StellarSail onboarding plan & CS owner assignment

Hi team —

Thanks again to everyone for the smooth close. Quick context so CS and Eng have what they need to start prep:

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $420k/year (3-year committed)
- Product: Hosted API (primary) with Dedicated capacity for peak workloads
- Go-live target: 2027-05-10 (pilot for internal ops by 2027-04-25)

Key success metrics (customer):
- 95th pct latency <= 250ms for 512-token requests
- <1% error rate at peak traffic
- Integration with SSO (SAML) + single-tenant logging to their Splunk instance

Operational constraints & notes (from pre-sale conversations):
- Data residency: US-only; customer will require audit logs retained 12 months
- Security: SOC 2 required (we have), plus an additional questionnaire they sent (attached)
- Network: they will run a VPN into our VPC for dedicated capacity; see network-requirements.txt attached

Ownership proposal
- CS owner: Marissa Cole (primary) — will lead kickoff and post-signing cadence
- Technical lead (pm/engineering): Vivek Kulkarni — implementation runbook + infra ops
- Escalation / renewals: Karthik Iyer (shadow)

Immediate asks
1) Marissa — please schedule an external kickoff for week of 3/22 or 3/25 (Oliver / Priya availability below).
2) Vivek — can you confirm dedicated capacity sizing (GPUs and burst policy) and pre-provisioning timeline by EOD 3/19?
3) Legal — I copied their legal team for the supplemental terms; legal to confirm DocuSign envelope complete (DocuSign:ENV-55321-SS).

Attachments: StellarSail_SOW_signed.pdf, SS-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx, network-requirements.txt

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if useful.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive\Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Jordan —

Appreciate the summary and congrats on closing. Quick notes from our side:
- 3/25 works best for our team for a kickoff (we can do morning PT)
- We flagged the SAML integration as highest priority — our identity team will need the SP metadata and test account.
- On logging: we will provide details for the Splunk collector; retention requirement confirmed at 12 months.

I’ve looped in Priya (ops) and our legal team. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks, we’ll lock 3/25 09:00 PT for a 60-minute kickoff (invites sent). Proposed agenda:
- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Implementation milestones & responsibilities (20m)
- SSO / network requirements (15m)
- Pilot plan & next steps (15m)

Pre-kickoff deliverables from us:
- Implementation checklist (attached) with owners filled in
- Sandbox keys and SP metadata for SAML (Vivek to send)
- Shared Drive folder + access for StellarSail (link in calendar invite)

Oliver — please flag any other stakeholders who should join the kickoff. We’ll treat this as the start of the 6-week pilot cadence.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StellarSail onboarding plan & CS owner assignment

Quick technical notes / blockers:
- Dedicated sizing: based on pre-sale telemetry, recommend 2x A10G nodes with 8 concurrent sessions (burst to 3x for ramp). Can prototype with hosted capacity while infra is provisioned.
- Network: need their VPN endpoint + IP allowlist by 3/22 to route pre-provisioning tests.
- SAML: I will provide SP metadata and a test account by EOD 3/19. Expecting minimal dev work from their side for initial test.
- Logs: We can forward JSON-formatted event streams to their Splunk HEC; need endpoint + token before pilot.

Also attaching a short runbook excerpt (see network-requirements.txt) — I’ll expand into the implementation checklist over the weekend.

— Vivek

- Jordan: Share pre-sale logs and annotated SLOs with CS — due 3/19 EOD

I’ll own meeting notes and the updated implementation checklist after kickoff. If anyone sees a different priority, flag it now.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this into execution.
